changelog: Fix: install button not working (replaced eval with script-tag injection). Fix: getApiBase() fallback when ApiClient unavailable. Fix: padStart() browser compat. Fix: flexbox gap fallback. Added initButtons() retry for DOM readiness.
description: Automatically stop playback after a user-defined duration. Features preset timers (15m-2h), a popup confirmation before stopping, and per-device install/uninstall from the dashboard.
name: Sleep Timer
